channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLbreakingNews, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Armed federal agents visit homes to check noncitizen voters
item.description: Uniformed and armed Department of Homeland Security agents have been knocking on doors to inquire about residents' immigration status.

item.title: Controversy arises over Winnie the Pooh's home
item.description: ABC News' Danny New looks into a dispute over whether the stuffed bear that inspired Winnie the Pooh belongs in England or the New York Public Library.

item.title: Ohio race ad featuring Amy Acton's mother sparks controversy
item.description: A new GOP ad shows Democrat Amy Acton's estranged mother calling her a liar. Acton's brother calls the ad a "despicable low" and mentions their stepfather.

item.title: Russia releases American Stephen Hubbard, Steve Witkoff says
item.description: U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff says Stephen Hubbard, a U.S. citizen jailed in Russia since 2022, has been released.
